metadata.name: Damn, Fiend Folio: RELOADED
metadata.description:
[img]https://file.garden/ai9jxcFD4DJrUqSq/reloaded/logo_reloaded_animated.gif[/img]
[img]https://file.garden/ai9jxcFD4DJrUqSq/reloaded/fiendfoliomod.png[/img] Can't keep a good [b]Fiend Folio MOD[/b] down!
With the power of [url=https://repentogon.com/]REPENTOGON[/url], we present to you the MOD's latest major update for Repentance+! Enjoy an influx of new monsters, bosses, items, and thousands of rooms! This makes the game more challenging, but don't let that scare you off!
Our team has had members work on Repentance, Last Judgement, Retribution, Fall From Grace, Revelations, Epiphany, Deliverance, Something Wicked, Restored Collection, Community Remix, Abortionbirth, a Disey Adventure and Devil's Harvest, so we hope you'll all have a good experience, and we thank everyone for being patient!
[img]https://file.garden/ai9jxcFD4DJrUqSq/reloaded/featurespurp.png[/img] [list] [*]An enormous overhaul to the game's floors, making them each much more distinct! [*]Over [b]700[/b] new monsters to fight! There's no friends in this basement. [*]An entire [b]30[/b] new bosses ready to kick ass! [*]Over [b]400[/b] fiendish items, and [b]150+[/b] wacky trinkets! [*]More than [b]80,000[/b] new rooms dispersed between the floors. [*]The prankster [b]Fiend[/b]! A glass cannon pyromancer who fights with his friends. [*]The stone-faced [b]Golem[/b]! With his unique pool of [b]100+[/b] rocks, geodes and fossils. [*]The gunslinger [b]Friend[/b]! An imp who channels her pyromancy into her fearsome revolver! [*][b]20+[/b] new challenges! Are you stronger than Golem? [*]Over [b]250[/b] unlocks! Play a fresh save and unlock everything, or hop right in with everything unlocked! [*]Two new curses! Easily disabled if you can't handle them! [*]Incorporated mods: Happy Items Pack, extracts from Guwah's Greatures and Something Wicked, Greg the Egg and more. [*]Heaps of tweaks and changes to help you feel at home! [*]Options! Open this menu with C or F1! [*]Lots and lots of rocks! [*]Piles and piles of guns! [*]Two new transformations! [*]New pill colours! [*]A shampoo bottle? [*]Plenty of surprises! [/list] We've tried our best to support other mods out there, but should you encounter any issues or clashes, please let us know in our [url=https://discord.gg/xVTxhpQ]community discord[/url]! Best played with the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2701118263]Excelsior[/url] music MOD! Make sure to have [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1348031964]Custom Stage API[/url] enabled! [img]https://file.garden/ai9jxcFD4DJrUqSq/spinningbook.gif[/img]
